rows.rewrite: net metering excess exported kWh carried forward or quarterly payment under pre‑2026 agreement
rows.answer:
Under the repealed Net‑Metering Regulations 2015, excess exported units were to be credited against the generator’s next billing cycle rather than paid quarterly [S1]. The rule is repealed, but it still applies to existing agreements according to the savings clause in the Prosumer Regulations 2026 [S6].

[S6] Prosumer Regs 2026, reg. 21(2), p. 7

rows.rewrite: DISCO meter reading procedures detection bill
rows.answer:
Meter reading of all DISCO consumers is done each month on a routine basis by DISCO staff, with consumers divided into batches and sub‑batches so that meters in a batch are read on the same dates each month [S2]. For connections equipped with an AMR system, a separate batch is created and billing is performed remotely according to a schedule made by DISCO [S1]. If a force‑majeure event prevents actual reading, the consumer may submit a meter‑reading snapshot or DISCO may issue a provisional bill based on last year’s or average consumption [S3].

[S2] Consumer Service Manual 2025, clause 6.1.1, p. 45
[S1] Consumer Service Manual 2025, clause 6.3, p. 48
[S3] Consumer Service Manual 2025, clause 6.1.1.1, p. 45
